A smarter way to remodel,without the headache.

Under the traditional contractor model, you hand over a deposit and hope your money is managed well. With Watchman, you never do: you hold your own funds and pay every trade and material invoice directly, at cost. Our only fee is for managing the process, start to finish, so there's never a reason to hide a number from you.

Whether you're renovating a kitchen, adding on, or doing a full-home remodel, we vet the trades, run the site, and keep the job on schedule and on budget, with you informed every step of the way.

All Services

Kitchen Remodels

Full kitchen transformations (cabinets, countertops, layout changes, plumbing, and electrical) managed from design to the final grout line.

Bathroom Renovations

Primary baths, guest baths, and powder rooms (tile, fixtures, vanities, and layouts) managed with a single point of contact and zero contractor juggling.

Home Additions

Need more space? We manage the design coordination, structural work, permitting, and all trades, delivering a seamless addition on time and on budget.

Full-Home Remodels

Whole-home renovations with a single point of contact. We coordinate every trade, review every invoice, and keep the project moving from demo to done.

Basement Finishing

Turn unused space into livable square footage: media rooms, wet bars, home gyms, or guest suites. We handle every trade from framing to final coat.

Master Suite Additions

Expand your primary bedroom and bath with a professionally managed addition. We vet the trades, run the site, and protect your budget at every step.

Four steps to a remodel you can trust

A clear process with no guesswork, from your first call to the day you move back in.

01

Discovery Call

We start by understanding your vision, goals, and budget. No pressure, just an honest conversation about what's possible and what it'll take.

02

Plan & Budget

We bring in trades for a bid walk so you meet them and see real proposals side by side, at cost with no markups. You choose who's hired before we proceed.

03

Build & Manage

Before work starts, we get every trade on a call to walk through the timeline together. Then we run daily site oversight and send you weekly updates, so you're always informed without being overwhelmed.

04

Final Walkthrough

We do a detailed punch-list inspection, make sure every detail meets your expectations, and hand over your finished space, ready to enjoy.
